name: Hell of my Design
source:
Two broke hitmen- turned odd jobs duo- find themselves with some sick [borrowed] wheels and rescue a damsel. The battle is over, but the road to Hell has just started.

[From [url=https://safffeine.itch.io/hell-of-my-design]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两名穷困潦倒、转行干起万事屋杂活的杀手，搞来了一辆炫酷的（借来的）座驾，还顺手救下了一名落难少女。战斗虽已落幕，但通往地狱的旅途才刚刚开始。

[摘自[url=https://safffeine.itch.io/hell-of-my-design]itch.io[/url]]
